Order book jhooth bhi bol sakti hai. 🎭

Kabhi bada order sirf dikhane ke liye lagta hai aur price paas aate hi gayab ho jata hai: spoofing (zyadatar bazaaron me gair-kanooni). Aur bade khiladi apna asli size chhupa kar thoda thoda dikhate hain: iceberg. Book me jo dikhta hai, wo vaada nahi hai.

Fair price kaun tay karta hai? 🤝

Fair price wo bhaav hai jise buyer aur seller dono theek samajhte hain. Price usse bahut upar jaye to buyers peeche hat sakte hain, bahut neeche jaye to sellers. Market isi value ke aas-paas ghoomta hai.

Gold ka asli volume kahan milega? 🥇

Spot gold ka koi ek central exchange nahi hai. Asli, gina hua volume futures market me milta hai. Har spot chart ka ek futures bhai hota hai.

Price ko hilata kaun hai, aur rokta kaun? ⚡

Aggressive trader market order se book ko khata hai, isliye price hilta hai. Passive trader apni jagah baitha rehta hai, wahi price ko rok sakta hai. Har move in dono ki ladaai hai.

Order book kya hoti hai? 📒

Mandi me har thele wale ne apna bhaav aur maal ek parchi pe likha hai. Saari parchiyan ek jagah rakho to wahi order book hai: har bhaav pe kitna maal intezaar me baitha hai.
